faq_heading: Citadel condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Citadel. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Citadel, Port Coquitlam: 23 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 4%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 3 of 10 Port Coquitlam communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Citadel rose from 18 in June to 23 in September (+27.8%), and 11 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 10.3% of Port Coquitlam’s 224 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Citadel?
Citadel also had 20 houses listed and 9 sold in September, against 23 condos and townhomes listed. The Citadel houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Citadel home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

31 townhomes sold in Citadel with a median price of $910,000 (the middle half sold between $874,000 and $1,076,500), taking a median of 12 days to sell at 98.1% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $463 per square foot, a median year built of 1993 and a median strata fee of $486 a month.

items.t: Boundary roads are UNVERIFIED — no City neighbourhood map states boundary roads for Citadel / Citadel Heights.

Where condo stock concentrates: there is no apartment-condo stock to concentrate. The attached shelf is townhouse complexes along Citadel Drive and Castle Crescent. The zoning bylaw's apartment zones RA1 and RA2 exist city-wide, but no Citadel apartment building was confirmed from an official or directory source.

Community (Port Coquitlam; medians are published at community level only, per-sub-area medians are NOT published) — detached median $1,262,500, $563/sq ft, 97% sale-to-list, 42 days on market; condos & townhomes median $660,000, $613/sq ft, 95% sale-to-list, 27 days on market. SnapStats GVR September 2026 report.

Roads and transit: Citadel Drive and Mary Hill Road serve the area, with Coast Meridian Road and the Coast Meridian Overpass connecting north Port Coquitlam to Lougheed Highway and the Mary Hill Bypass. TransLink buses serve north Port Coquitlam from Coquitlam Central Station and Port Coquitlam Station, and the West Coast Express stops at Port Coquitlam Station (downtown, outside this sub-area); specific route numbers stopping inside Citadel are UNVERIFIED.

Schools and catchments: SD43 catchments are address-based. A School Locator run for the sample address Citadel Middle School, 1265 Citadel Drive, returned Hazel Trembath Elementary, Ecole Citadel Middle and École Riverside Secondary (SD43 School Locator Tool, Baragar, run 2026-10-23). Other SD43 schools in this part of the north side include Castle Park Elementary. Any other address in the sub-area is UNVERIFIED until run.

Recreation: Castle Park is beside the Citadel area on the Pitt River side, the Traboulay PoCo Trail network crosses the city, Hyde Creek Recreation Centre at 1379 Laurier Avenue is the north-side recreation centre, and the Terry Fox Library is downtown at the Port Coquitlam Community Centre, 2150 Wilson Avenue.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Citadel PQ

items.t: Port Coquitlam property taxes: for 2026, due July 2, 2026; a 5% penalty applies to current taxes not paid before end of day July 2, 2026, and an additional 5% penalty applies to current taxes outstanding after September 15, 2026. The City's 2026 increase was 1.95% for the average home, and the City states it has the lowest average property taxes and utility fees in Metro Vancouver; utility bills are flat annual water and sewer fees, billed separately and due March 31, 2026.

blocks.text: Good to know about Citadel PQ

items.t: Detached and attached homes here move at opposite speeds. SnapStats GVR September 2026 report.

The gated complex's own paperwork contradicts its marketing shorthand. Citadel Pointe carries an "adult oriented" site-influence tag in listings, but the MLS sheet for a unit there lists pet bylaws only and no age restriction — and its building-directory line still prints a rental restriction that has been void since November 24, 2022. Two separate listing-era artefacts, both settled only by the bylaws on the Form B.

The OCP leaves a door open at Citadel's edges. The Official Community Plan supports an appropriate neighbourhood commercial development in the Citadel area — worth a City conversation for corner or edge lots, and a land-use watch item for nearby owners.

There is no SkyTrain coming to Port Coquitlam on any funded timeline. TransLink's Transport 2050: 10-Year Priorities commits only to an "exploratory business case" for a Millennium Line extension to Port Coquitlam, still simply "underway" in the Mayors' Council's Feb 19, 2026 work plan — no route, stations, funding or dates approved. Citadel buyers commute by bus to Coquitlam Central or by the commuter-only West Coast Express from downtown.

Flood works are underway elsewhere in the city. The City's Cedar Drainage Pump Station, part of the Pitt River dike system, is being rebuilt with construction scheduled summer 2026 to summer 2027 — a reminder that the dike system behind the city's low-lying areas is active infrastructure, even for buyers on Citadel's high ground checking lot-level status.

Citadel Pointe — 678 and 688 Citadel Drive. STRATA (Freehold Strata, Plan LMS3766), built 1999.

A gated townhome complex managed by FirstService Residential, with its own strata website; the building directory records it built in 1999, while unit listings in the complex show 1999–2001 — a single complex-wide build year beyond the directory's 1999 for the 688 Citadel Drive entry is UNCONFIRMED. An MLS data sheet for 52 678 Citadel Drive records Complex/Subdivision "Citadel Pointe," Title to Land "Freehold Strata," Legal "Strata Lot 52, Plan LMS3766," Year Built 1999, and bylaw restrictions "Cats OK, Dogs OK, Number Limit (Two), Yes With Restrictions" — the published pet position stands as a public-source statement, confirmed on the Form B. Unit count: UNCONFIRMED — the legal description text read is garbled on the unit total (an MLS legal description references a 168-unit entitlement figure, which is not carried as a unit count). blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Citadel PQ

items.t: Form B diligence (every Citadel strata): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. A complex's registered bylaws are the diligence, not a directory line or an MLS site-influence tag.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Citadel?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 23 condos and townhomes listed in Citadel. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Citadel a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Citadel had a sales ratio of 4%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Citadel from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 11 condos and townhomes sold in Citadel over those 4 months, out of 151 in all of Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Citadel sell for?
faq.a: 31 townhomes sold in Citadel between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $910,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Citadel?
faq.a: The median was 12 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.1% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Is there any 55+ housing I can buy in Citadel?
faq.a: No — not on any source checked. No Citadel strata is verified to carry a 55+ bylaw. Port Coquitlam's one verified 55+ strata is Mayfair Terrace downtown (2266 Atkins Ave, Central Port Coquitlam).

faq.q: A listing calls Citadel Pointe "adult oriented." Does that make it 55+?
faq.a: No. "Adult oriented" is an MLS site-influence tag, not a bylaw. The MLS sheet checked for Citadel Pointe lists pet bylaws only, with no age restriction — and under BC law the only valid strata age bylaw is a 55+ bylaw under Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Citadel townhome?
faq.a: Long-term rental-restriction bylaws are void province-wide since November 24, 2022, whatever an older MLS sheet or directory line still prints (including Citadel Pointe's "rentals allowed w/restrictions" directory element). A strata can still restrict short-term rentals.

faq.q: Are pets allowed in Citadel's townhome complexes?
faq.a: At Citadel Pointe, the MLS sheet checked lists cats OK, dogs OK, with a two-pet number limit and restrictions, and the directory records pets allowed with restrictions. Other complexes: check the specific strata's bylaws on the Form B — pet rules are building-by-building.
